stories.title: Knoxville Master Firefighter Ronnie Layne dies after serving the department for nearly 20 years, KFD says
stories.summary: The Knoxville Fire Department said Layne passed on Nov. 13 with his loved ones by his side.

stories.title: Country music community mourns Richard Sterban of celebrated quartet The Oak Ridge Boys
stories.summary: The Grand Ole Opry announced Sterban's death at 83 on Nov. 14 and said the Opry on Nov. 21 will be dedicated in his honor.

stories.title: LCSO: 19-year-old charged after high-speed police chase in Blount County ends in crash with multiple injuries
stories.summary: The Loudon County Sheriff's Office said Michael Ghaster drove over 130 mph during the chase and is facing charges including evading arrest and vehicular assault.

stories.title: 'People were scared:' McGhee Tyson travelers describe confusion during nationwide FAA ground stop
stories.summary: Passengers at McGhee Tyson described fear, disrupted plans and delays after the FAA's nationwide ground stop left travelers waiting for answers Friday night.

stories.title: Tennessee football travel plans to Texas A&M impacted after FAA issues nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: The ground stop was issued minutes before the Vols were supposed to take off from McGhee Tyson Airport at 4 p.m. on Friday.

stories.title: WBIR former and current employees reflect on Gatlinburg wildfires, 10 years later
stories.summary: The wildfires devastated parts of Gatlinburg and Sevier County on the night of Nov. 28, 2016, taking 14 lives and destroying hundreds of homes and businesses.

stories.title: UT students use AI to develop financial technology in inaugural FinTech at Rocky Top competition
stories.summary: University of Tennessee students are creatively leveraging AI to transform business ideas into tech solutions at the inaugural FinTech at Rocky Top competition.

stories.title: WBIR Pioneers: The Reverend & Lady Mull spent decades sharing the gospel with East Tennessee
stories.summary: Channel 10 T.V. turns 70 in 2026 and we're looking back at the pioneers who took a chance on a new medium called television, including J. Bazzel and Lady Mull.

stories.title: Knoxville, Knox County prepare 700 shelter beds for winter
stories.summary: The Office of Housing Stability and partners will provide shelter, transportation and meals to those experiencing homelessness.

stories.title: Former fire chief reflects on 2016 Gatlinburg wildfires nearly 10 years later
stories.summary: Nearly 10 years after the Gatlinburg wildfires, a former fire chief reflects on the challenges her crews faced and the memories that have stayed with her.

stories.title: Neighbors react to new hotel moving to the Old City
stories.summary: People in Knoxville's Old City reacted to plans for a new Moxy by Marriott hotel. Some welcomed the development, while others worried about parking challenges.

stories.title: East Tennessee mental health program expands, helping more people access affordable therapy
stories.summary: The Mental Health Association of East Tennessee is helping more people access affordable therapy through its growing Treatment Access Bank program.
